CustomField.description: DIR-869: System flag - true when this Quote's displayed totals (NetUnitPrice/TotalPrice/NetTotalPrice) may no longer match its current discount state and a Reprice All is needed. Set true only by RES_Autolaunched_Revert_Quote_Discount_On_Rejection when a rejected discount is reverted. Cleared (false) by RES_Quote_Before_Save_Clear_Pricing_Stale_Flag when the Quote is actually repriced (LastPricedDate changes), and by RES_Quote_Line_Item_After_Update_Sync_Header_Discount when a new discount is entered on the root line item. Drives the pricing-stale warning banner on the Quote page (visibility rule on this field) - not used in any validation/blocking logic.
CustomField.label: Pricing Stale
